title: A hybrid quantum network linking telecom-wavelength atomic and solid-state nodes
summary: Photonic links between disparate quantum technologies$-$such as photon sources, memories, processors, clocks, and sensors$-$are key to scaling quantum networks and realizing a versatile quantum internet for secure quantum communication, distributed quantum computing, and entanglement-enhanced metrology. In practice, each technology is most suitably implemented on a different quantum platform; the substantial spectral mismatch between them, along with scarce native telecom interfaces, thus poses a major bottleneck to achieving efficient interconnections over long distances.
